id: 22_10 Electrical Safety Rules Every Worker Must Know @HSE STUDY GUIDE
title: 十条用电安全规则
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/22_10 Electrical Safety Rules Every Worker Must Know @HSE STUDY GUIDE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/22_10 Electrical Safety Rules Every Worker Must Know @HSE STUDY GUIDE/src.py

points.K9: 规则八：定期检查线和设备
points.K11: 规则十：先培训，合格者作业
points.S1: 自制、改装电气装置要评估

shots.scene: 欣欣站在工作间门口，身后十个空白卡片排成一排
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a lab workshop with ten blank cards lined up on the wall behind it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲十条用电安全规则。

shots.scene: 闪电、锁、手套、水滴、插头五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a padlock, an insulating glove, a water droplet and a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 记住它们，远离触电和电气火灾。

shots.scene: 实验楼工作间，一台设备的电源刚被关掉，老李准备检修
shots.prompt_en: In a lab workshop, the facility engineer prepares to repair a machine that has just been switched off.
shots.narration: 工作间的一台设备要检修。

shots.scene: 阿杰说开关关了，伸手就要摸接线端子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student says the switch is off and reaches toward the open terminal block of the machine.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：开关关了，没电了。

shots.scene: 老李拦住他，举起验电笔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops him and holds up a voltage tester pen.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：没验过，就当它有电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在一排空白卡片前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the row of blank cards and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这正是第一条规则。

shots.scene: 十张空白卡片逐一点亮
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank cards on a board light up one by one, each with a small number circle. No people.
shots.narration: 十条规则，每个人都要知道。

shots.scene: 老李和小研并排站着
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student stand side by side in the workshop.
shots.narration: 电工照着做，学生要懂、要配合。

shots.scene: 一根电线旁画着闪电和问号
shots.prompt_en: A wire on a workbench with a lightning bolt icon and a question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 任何电线和设备，都先当作带电。

shots.scene: 老李用验电笔检测接线端子，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing insulating gloves, checks the terminal block with a voltage tester pen; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 就算觉得已断电，也要验电确认。

shots.scene: 两个人传话出错、开关没断干净两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: two people with a broken speech bubble between them, and a half-open switch with a spark. No people.
shots.narration: 很多事故，源于沟通出错或没断干净。

shots.scene: 老李拉下开关，挂上挂锁和空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the breaker and attaches a padlock and a blank red tag.
shots.narration: 检修前，断电后上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 有人伸手去合闸，被锁挡住，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching for the locked breaker, blocked by the padlock, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 检修期间，谁也不能重新送电。

shots.scene: 老李穿戴绝缘手套、阻燃工作服、护目镜、绝缘鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears insulating gloves, a flame-resistant work suit, safety goggles and insulating boots.
shots.narration: 电工作业，穿戴合适的防护用品。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜站在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing safety goggles and a lab coat, watches from a safe distance.
shots.narration: 在旁边协助，也要做好防护。

shots.scene: 远处的架空电线和变压器图标
shots.prompt_en: An outdoor campus scene with overhead power lines and a transformer box in the distance. No people.
shots.narration: 架空线、地下电缆，都可能带电。

shots.scene: 电压越高，安全距离圆圈越大
shots.prompt_en: Three concentric distance circles around a power line icon, growing larger as a voltage bar rises. No people.
shots.narration: 电压越高，要离得越远。

shots.scene: 举着长杆靠近电线的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person carrying a long metal pole near overhead lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不靠近、不触碰，具体距离按国内规定。

shots.scene: 胶柄螺丝刀和绝缘钳
shots.prompt_en: An insulated screwdriver and insulated pliers with thick rubber handles on a workbench. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近带电部位，用绝缘手柄的工具。

shots.scene: 绝缘柄破裂的工具，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A screwdriver with a cracked handle and bare metal showing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手柄破损的工具，不能再用。

shots.scene: 水滴和闪电图标靠在一起，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A water droplet icon touching a lightning bolt icon with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 水让触电的风险大大增加。

shots.scene: 湿滑地面、湿工具、湿手三个图标，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: a wet slippery floor, a dripping tool and a wet hand near a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 湿地面、湿工具、湿手，都要避开。

shots.scene: 阿杰先把地上的水擦干，再去插电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student mops up water on the floor before plugging in a machine.
shots.narration: 先排水擦干，再用电。

shots.scene: 老李查看潮湿场所的专用设备
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a sealed waterproof socket box in a damp room.
shots.narration: 必须在潮湿处用电，由专业人员安排。

shots.scene: 一个插座插满多个大功率插头，冒热气
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one wall outlet crowded with many high-power plugs, with heat waves rising. No people.
shots.narration: 一个插座插太多电器，

shots.scene: 发热、起火、设备损坏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a hot glowing cable, a small flame and a broken instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 会过热、起火，或烧坏设备。

shots.scene: 大功率设备各接专用插座，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A drying oven and a heater each plugged into its own dedicated wall socket with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备，各用各的插座。

shots.section_title: 规则八：定期检查线和设备
shots.scene: 小研拿起电源线仔细查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up an instrument power cord and inspects it closely.
shots.narration: 电线和设备，要定期检查。
overlay: 规则八：定期检查线和设备

shots.section_title: 规则八：定期检查线和设备
shots.scene: 磨损的线、破损的绝缘层、裸露的导体三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a frayed wire, cracked insulation and an exposed bare conductor, each with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 磨损、破皮、露铜，会触电也会起火。

shots.section_title: 规则八：定期检查线和设备
shots.scene: 日历图标，日、周、月三个格子打勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with three boxes checked for daily, weekly and monthly. No people.
shots.narration: 按使用情况，每天、每周、每月查。

shots.scene: 仪器金属外壳接着黄绿接地线
shots.prompt_en: The metal case of a lab instrument connected by a green and yellow wire to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，给故障电流一条安全通路。

shots.scene: 故障电流沿接地线流走，人图标旁打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A fault current arrow flows down the ground wire to earth, while a person pictogram nearby has a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 防止触电，也保护设备。

shots.section_title: 规则十：先培训，合格者作业
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 接触电气系统前，先接受培训。
overlay: 规则十：先培训，合格者作业

shots.section_title: 规则十：先培训，合格者作业
shots.scene: 一群小人图标，大部分未经培训的被标红
shots.prompt_en: A group of person pictograms, most of those without a training badge highlighted in red with a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 电气死亡事故中，很多是没受过培训的人。

shots.section_title: 规则十：先培训，合格者作业
shots.scene: 老李手持空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 电气作业，只能由合格持证人员做。

shots.section_title: 自制、改装电气装置要评估
shots.scene: 零散电线拼装的自制加热装置图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a homemade heating device built from loose wires and a bare heating element, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 自制或改装电气装置，不能随手就用。
overlay: 自制、改装电气装置要评估

shots.section_title: 自制、改装电气装置要评估
shots.scene: 小研把空白申请表交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a blank application form to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 先报告导师和实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 自制、改装电气装置要评估
shots.scene: 老李检查装置的绝缘和接地，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the insulation and ground connection of a lab-built device and checks a blank list.
shots.narration: 经专业人员评估合格，才能通电。

shots.scene: 老李检修，老周站在开关旁看护
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works on a machine while the older man stands by the breaker watching him.
shots.narration: 电气作业，不要一个人干。

shots.scene: 监护人手放在开关旁，随时准备断电
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the older man's hand resting near the breaker handle, ready to switch it off.
shots.narration: 监护人盯住现场，出事立即断电。

shots.scene: 一个人独自在夜间工作间接线的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lone person working on wiring in a dark workshop at night, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 深夜、独自一人，不做电气作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白清单，旁边三个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank checklist with three question mark icons beside it.
shots.narration: 动手前，先想一想。

shots.scene: 电源、工具、人员三个图标逐一打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons checked one by one: a power switch, a toolbox and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 电源断了吗？工具好吗？人到位吗？

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰对着空白清单交底
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student review a blank checklist together before starting work.
shots.narration: 说清步骤和风险，再开始干。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现验电笔和挂锁图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a voltage tester pen and a padlock with a tag.
shots.narration: 当作带电先验电，检修上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 防护用品、绝缘工具、远离电线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of insulating gloves, an insulated screwdriver and an overhead line with a keep-away arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴防护，用绝缘工具，远离电线。

shots.scene: 水滴打叉、插座不超载、放大镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crossed-out water droplet, a single plug in a socket and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 远离潮湿，不超载，常检查。

shots.scene: 接地符号和培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ground symbol and a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 做好接地，先培训，持证作业。

shots.scene: 申请表、两个人、清单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank application form, two person pictograms and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 改装要评估，作业有监护，先评估风险。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的工作间里挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in a tidy lab workshop.
shots.narration: 守住十条规则，安全用电，下次见！
